description: Experiment B (research only): fine-tune the Yakimov Hb EfficientNet-B0 on annotated nail crops; patient-level evaluation. Not a production inference pathway.
loss: SmoothL1Loss on train-normalised Hb (same as production and Experiment A)

annotations.box_format: [y1, x1, y2, x2] in pixels of the stored 800x600 image (verified visually and by bounds)

crop.shape: square, centred on the box; side = max(box width, box height) x (1 + 2 x margin)
crop.outside_image: square shifted to stay inside the photo (real pixels; no padding or background replacement)
crop.resize: 224x224 bilinear (median 3.0x, max 5.0x upscale; square-to-square, no aspect distortion)
crop.colour_preprocessing: EXIF transpose -> RGB -> ToTensor -> ImageNet normalisation (identical to production)

augmentation.colour_changes: none (nail-bed colour is the Hb evidence)

patient_aggregation: mean of the 3 nail-crop Hb predictions (g/dL) per patient; all metrics and model selection at patient level
deployment_status: research-only: the live webcam pipeline has no validated nail-region detector
